We will check his lamotrigine level and consider dose optimisation once results are available. I have also arranged a sleep-deprived EEG to assess for any interictal abnormalities. He has been provided with written safety advice, including not driving and avoiding operating machinery until seizure control is re-established.

- Safety advice: continue standard seizure precautions, including bathing with door unlocked, avoiding heights without supervision, and avoiding swimming alone. Driving advice remains unchanged based on recent episodes; the patient understands current regulations and responsibilities.
